Nina (AE): FYI wehave SummitBoard on a tight exec timeline. CFO asked for a single-page committed cost example + security confirmation for BYOK and egress controls by COB today.

Tom (Solutions): Copy. I can produce a one-pager with two scenarios: hosted w/commit and dedicated private cluster. Will include cost delta and latency expectations.

Priya (Security): Need to confirm: they require customer-managed keys with HSM-wrapped envelope keys, key rotation every 90 days, and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. We'll need to confirm SLA on key access.

Dmitri (NetOps): For network: they want private peering + static egress IPs and the option to force all outbound through their inspection appliance. We can do a routed peering + NAT gateway. Ask them for ASN and egress CIDRs.

Nina (AE): Good. Also CFO asked for an "apples-to-apples" committed price for 8M tokens/month + steady-state 1x A40-equivalent and burst to 2x for peaks.

Tom (Solutions): Quick draft numbers (placeholder): hosted commit (8M tokens) = $A/month; dedicated reserve 1 GPU = $B/month; burst 2 GPUs add-on = $C/month. I'll convert to exact after pricing sheet.

Priya (Security): Addendum: confirm KMS storage scope: envelope keys only; model artifacts encrypted at rest with customer KEK; control plane never holds unwrapped keys. I'll state that plainly. :shield:

Ivy (GC): Legal note: they asked about data access during POC. We can allow limited audit and a signed NDA for any targeted access. Standard trial T&Cs apply; if they want broader audit rights we escalate to Enterprise SOW.

Tom (Solutions): Network snippet for the brief (example):
```peer-asn: 64512
peer-cidr: 172.31.8.0/24
bgp: true
static-egress: [198.51.100.12]
force-tunnel: supported
```

Dmitri (NetOps): Also include fallback: transient VPN if peering not provisioned within 72h; explain latency delta.

Priya (Security): Will answer their short security questionnaire and flag anything requiring additional controls. If they ask for pentest, we coordinate a 2-week window.

ops-bot: Reservation created: summitboard-poc (1 steady GPU, reserve 2 for burst) 2024-06-09T18:00Z. Reservation ID: res-7f8e9d0c.

Nina (AE): Action items: Tom = one-page cost comparison + two-line latency note (3pm PT). Priya = completed questionnaire answers + KMS blurb (3pm PT). Dmitri = network diagram + fallback plan (3pm PT). Ivy = legal blurb for exec slide. I'll assemble and send to VP by 15:30 PT.

Tom (Solutions): Quick question  do we want to call out quantized model options in the cost comparison? It materially lowers token cost for batch workloads.

Priya (Security): Yes call it out but mark as "subject to quality validation". Security fine either way.

Ivy (GC): Add legal: 30-day POC termination, standard limitation of liability, and agreed-upon support window for trial.

Nina (AE): Thanks. If anything blocks, ping me and I'll escalate to Head of Sales.

Tom (Solutions): Uploading draft PDF to the shared drive now.

Dmitri (NetOps): Uploaded network PNG and sample firewall rules.

Priya (Security): Uploaded questionnaire answers. A few Qs marked "requires design review".

Nina (AE): Got everything. Sending to VP at 15:27 PT for signoff. :rocket:
